34caf311b8.q: What is the core marketing challenge of selling kids beverages when the decision-maker is the parent, not the child?
34caf311b8.a: Products made for kids have to win twice: first with the kid to build desirability through packaging and taste, then with the parent by making it easy to say yes through clean nutrition and positioning it as an everyday treat rather than a big indulgence. No Biggie tested plain aluminum cans with 500 families to validate taste without visual bias, then designed the full experience with game boards and prompts to appeal to both audiences simultaneously.

dc7b116768.q: What do brands fundamentally misunderstand about building community as a growth strategy?
dc7b116768.a: Community is an output, not an input. Brands cannot force community by simply creating affiliate programs or branded WhatsApp groups. True community emerges only when you authentically create connection and people relate to one another on shared values and shared experiences, not through algorithms or mass emails.

11a19195b5.q: What are the key initiatives and events the Downtown Detroit Partnership is planning for the 2024 holiday season?
11a19195b5.a: The Downtown Detroit Partnership is planning the Detroit tree lighting as a major event, preparing corporate sponsorship opportunities that typically sell out, lining up talent, and organizing the lighting of the tallest red kettle. bd3728bb60.q: What is the Future of Health project partnership between Henry Ford Health System, MSU, and the Pistons?
bd3728bb60.a: The Future of Health project is a $3.3 billion investment that encompasses a new state-of-the-art 20-story hospital being built for technologies that don't exist yet, partnering with Michigan Central on development. It also includes a seven-story research building with MSU right next to Henry Ford's current corporate offices. These investments are intended to benefit people in Detroit through job creation and better healthcare access, while also attracting top medical talent to the city.

1322e2e80d.q: What is the Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute at Henry Ford Health System?
1322e2e80d.a: The Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute will be housed in Henry Ford's new research center opening in 2027. It is the first brick-and-mortar facility in the world dedicated to researching neurofibromatosis, a rare condition that causes tumors to grow on the nerves throughout the body. Nick Gilbert is Dan Gilbert's son who had this condition, and while the center will focus on other conditions as well, this institute represents a major commitment to research infrastructure.
